portion_doctrine: Segments 21-30 are NOT substantive YouTube Skool content. They contain GitHub repository documentation (OpenClaw personal AI assistant, Taste Skill design framework, Impeccable design tool, awesome-design-md collection, Clickhouse database). No real operating rules, methods, tactics, or prompts from YouTube Skool education appear in this range. Assessed as 95% boilerplate (repos, contributors lists, install instructions, feature documentation) with 5% skimmable patterns (design skills, multi-agent orchestration). Recommend earlier segments for actual educational content.
